messages:
Sam — AE: Kicking off POC with ACME tomorrow. Need alignment on success criteria and cost/SLOs. Customer expects 3 main flows: chat support summarization, knowledge search rerank, and code-gen assist. Who can own test plan?

Maya — Solutions Eng: I can take lead on test plan. Quick q: do we need formal evals or just sample prompts?

Sam — AE: They want both: automated evals + manual QA for edge cases. Also security questionnaire on CIAM.

Jitendra — Infra Eng: For SLOs, propose p50 < 120ms, p95 < 450ms for short chats (<=256 tokens). For embeddings/semantic search, target p95 ~150ms. Cost target: aim to keep per-1k-token POC cost under $0.60 (including preprocessing). These are doable with batching + int8 quant.

Maya — Solutions Eng: Agreed. For acceptance: automated evals >= 90% intent-match + manual sample pass rate >= 92%. We'll define a prompt set of ~200 examples and an edge-case subset of ~40. Canary fallback to smaller model if latency spikes.

Olivia — CSM: Timeline: 2-week POC. Week 1: setup + smoke runs. Week 2: full evals and handover. Customer requires signed NDA and a completed security questionnaire before infra access.

sec-bot: Security questionnaire link: https://redwood.work/sgq/acme-2026

Sam — AE: Pricing? They asked about committed vs pay-as-you-go. Any guidance for quoting POC credits vs discounted trial?

Jitendra — Infra Eng: For POC keep them on PAYG but include $3k credit and a dedicated staging node for peak runs. If they convert within 30 days, credit applies to first month of a dedicated commit. Also recommend setting a soft budget alert at $2k.

Maya — Solutions Eng: I'll draft the runbook and the eval harness. Plan to include: prompt sets, rouge/bleu where applicable, semantic-sim thresholds using embedding cosine >= 0.82, latency/cost logs, and rollback criteria. Acceptance matrix will have explicit thresholds for latency, cost per 1k tokens, and quality pass rate.

Sam — AE: Can you paste a skeleton curl for generating evals?

Maya — Solutions Eng: Sure:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model": "rwd-3b-lab", "input": "<prompt>", "max_tokens": 128}'
```

Olivia — CSM: I'll coordinate security questionnaire and legal. Jitendra, can you provision a private test instance (staging) with monitoring + tracing hooks?

Jitendra — Infra Eng: Yep — will spin up staging with kv-cache on, batch window 20ms, and tracing enabled. ETA 24h. Will also attach a cost meter and p95 latency dashboard.

Sam — AE: Great. Action items: Maya draft runbook + prompt set by EOD today, Jitendra provision staging in 24h, Olivia send security link to customer. Reconvene tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:

Maya — Solutions Eng: Ack. I'll include the acceptance matrix and a simple dashboard config (latency, cost, quality).

Olivia — CSM: Noted — I'll block time and prep the questionnaire.

sec-bot: Deploy log: staging cluster created rwd-staging-acme by jitu at 1769999000
